Password Security

A strong password is your first line of defense against cyberattacks. Learn how to create unbreakable passwords and keep your accounts safe.

Why Passwords Matter

Hackers use automated programs to guess millions of passwords a second. If your password is too short or uses common words, it can be cracked almost instantly. A strong, unique password ensures that even if a hacker finds your username, they can't access your data.

password123

Weak: Too short, common word, no special characters.

Hello123!

Medium: Better, but still too common. Add symbols and length.

P@ssw0rd!2026#

Strong: Long, mixed case, numbers, and special characters. Excellent!

Test Your Password

Empty
✗ At least 8 characters
✗ Contains uppercase letter (A-Z)
✗ Contains lowercase letter (a-z)
✗ Contains a number (0-9)
✗ Contains special character (!@#$%^&*)

Password Safety Tips

✗

Never Share

Never share your password with anyone, not even your friends.

⚿

Be Unique

Use a different password for every account you create.

▤

Use a Manager

Consider using a password manager to remember complex passwords.

⎋

Enable 2FA

Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) whenever possible for extra security.
